name: Loudness in Bounds
hint: The loudness sensor reports values from 0 to 100, so sound levels can be compared and processed meaningfully.
instruction: Choose loudness thresholds between 0 and 100 and validate the reading before using it in a condition.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@codeyB loudness :: sensing) > (50)> then
say [Loud sound]
end
